'''Elsa Beatriz Abuin Saccomano''' (13 December 1942 – 18 April 2012) was an Argentine chemist. After fleeing the country due to [[La Noche de los Bastones Largos]], she became a professor at [[University of Chile]]. A 1987 [[Guggenheim Fellow]], she specialized in physical chemistry, especially in [[chemical kinetics]].

==Biography==
Elsa Beatriz Abuin Saccomano was born on 13 December 1942 in Buenos Aires, Argentina.<ref name="GF" /> After getting her BS in chemistry at the [[University of Buenos Aires]] in 1966, she intended to do her graduate studies in Argentina, before her research group fled the country due to the [[La Noche de los Bastones Largos]].<ref name="GF" /><ref name="scielo" /> Led by Juan Grotewold and Eduardo Lissi, the Grotewold-Lissi group later settled at the [[University of Chile|Technical University of the State]] (UTE), where she was a professor at the Department of Engineering and got her PhD in chemistry in 1974; her dissertation ''Fotoquímica de cetonas alifáticas en fase gaseosa'' was supervised by Lissi, and they would later author well over a dozen articles together afterwards.<ref name="GF" /><ref name="scielo" /><ref name="wiley" />

Originally a teaching assistant, she later remained in TUE as part of their Kinetics and Photochemistry research group, as well as a full professor of chemistry, as a research scientist, and as director of the Faculty of Chemistry and Biology's graduate program.<ref name="wiley" /><ref name="scielo" /><ref name="GF" /> She also spent time abroad as a visiting professor at the [[National University of Río Cuarto]] and [[University of São Paulo]].<ref name="scielo">{{Cite journal |last=Aliaga |first=Carolina |date=2013 |title=Obituary Dra. Elsa Beatriz Abuin Saccomano |journal=Journal of the Chilean Chemical Society |language=en |volume=58 |issue=4 |pages=1935 |doi=10.4067/S0717-97072013000400003 |issn=0717-9707|doi-access=free }}</ref>

As an academic, she specialized in physical chemistry, especially in [[chemical kinetics]].<ref name="wiley" /> In 1987, she published ''Macromoleculas en Solución'', a UNESCO monograph.<ref name="GF" /> A long time contributor to the University of Santiago's series on physical chemistry books, she edited the fourth volume, which was published after her death in 2013.<ref name="scielo" /><ref name="wiley" /> The journal ''[[Photochemistry and Photobiology]]'' said that she "was, without any doubt, a pillar in the development and consolidation of the chemical sciences in Chile".<ref name="wiley" />

In 1987, she was awarded a [[Guggenheim Fellowship]]<ref>{{Cite web |title=Elsa Beatriz Abuin |url=https://www.gf.org/fellows/elsa-beatriz-abuin-2/ |access-date=2024-10-01 |website=John Simon Guggenheim Memorial Foundation |language=en}}</ref> for "a study of fluorescence probing of colloidal particles".<ref name="GF">{{Cite book |url=https://books.google.com/books?id=AZxPAQAAIAAJ |title=Reports of the President and the Treasurer |publisher=John Simon Guggenheim Memorial Foundation |year=1986 |page=131}}</ref> she was the first Chilean woman to receive the fellowship.<ref name="scielo" /> As part of the Fellowship, she did research in North America at the [[University of Rochester]] and [[University of Ottawa]],<ref name="scielo" /> the latter of where she worked under [[Tito Scaiano]].<ref name="wiley" />

She also co-founded the Encuentros Latinoamericanos de Fotoquímica y Fotobiología conference and was an organizer as late as the 2010 conference.<ref name="wiley" />

Abuin died on 18 April 2012.<ref>{{Cite journal |last1=Durantini |first1=Andrés M. |last2=Falcone |first2=R. Darío |last3=Anunziata |first3=Jorge D. |last4=Silber |first4=Juana J. |last5=Abuin |first5=Elsa B. |last6=Lissi |first6=Eduardo A. |last7=Correa |first7=N. Mariano |date=2013-02-21 |title=An Interesting Case Where Water Behaves as a Unique Solvent. 4-Aminophthalimide Emission Profile to Monitor Aqueous Environment |url=https://pubs.acs.org/doi/10.1021/jp310854s |journal=The Journal of Physical Chemistry B |language=en |volume=117 |issue=7 |pages=2160–2168 |doi=10.1021/jp310854s |pmid=23347065 |issn=1520-6106|hdl=11336/23475 |hdl-access=free |url-access=subscription }}</ref> ''[[Photochemistry and Photobiology]]'' published a special memorial issue dedicated to Abuin.<ref name="wiley">{{Cite journal |last1=Alarcon |first1=Emilio Isaac |last2=Aspee |first2=Alexis |last3=Aliaga |first3=Carolina |last4=Braslavsky |first4=Silvia E. |date=2013 |title=Special Issue Dedicated to the Memory of Elsa Beatriz Abuin Saccomano (1942–2012) |url=https://onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/10.1111/php.12115 |journal=Photochemistry and Photobiology |language=en |volume=89 |issue=6 |pages=1270–1272 |doi=10.1111/php.12115 |pmid=24580136 |issn=0031-8655|url-access=subscription }}</ref>
